text: The Ribenboim Prize, named in honour of Paulo Ribenboim, is awarded by the Canadian Number Theory Association to recognize distinguished research in number theory by a mathematician who is Canadian or has significant ties to Canadian mathematics. Typically, the recipient has obtained their Ph.D. within the past 12 years, and is expected to deliver a plenary talk at the award ceremony. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, the prizes for 2020, 2022, and 2024 were all conferred in 2024.
